name: list-export-commitment-pdf
title: Commitment list PDF
description: A commitment list as a PDF on Letter, by permit section in code order: a summary table, then each commitment with its requirements in the permit’s words.

sections.label: Print route + data
sections.html:
Quarterly Agency Briefing

Read into the quarterly briefing deck for the resource agencies.

Type
Commitment List
Project
Delta Conveyance

guide.intent: A commitment list as the PDF its Export card downloads: title block, a summary table with one line per commitment, then each commitment with its requirements in the permit's words, from a new page.
decisions: Print route: `commitment-list/:commitmentListID` in print.routes.ts, beside the other list routes, guarded by printAuthGuard.
Data: the endpoint the list tree and the CSV read, `commitmentListsCommitmentListIDTreeGet` (its Commitments), plus the list detail for Name and Description.
Groups are permit sections ("COA 10"), commitments in code order inside each (the CSV's compareByCode).
Download: `GET commitment-lists/{commitmentListID}/generate-pdf`, file named `{list.Name}.pdf`, Letter via the PdfService paper option.
An empty list still exports: the title block with a count of 0 and no body.
gotchas: The prototype's requirement text is cut short in its fixture (it ends in an ellipsis). Prod prints the full requirement text.
A long commitment can run past a page. `break-inside: avoid` keeps short ones whole; Chromium lets a taller one break, which is right.
acceptance: Every commitment on the list appears once in the summary and once in the detail, in code order.

guide.intent: One line per commitment: Commitment (its code), Title, and how many requirements it holds, under full-width permit-section rows.
decisions: Same single-table build as the other list PDFs: one <thead> that repeats on every page.
acceptance: The requirement count on each line equals the requirements printed under that commitment in the detail.

guide.intent: One commitment in the detail: its title with the code at the right margin, then each requirement: its name, then its text.
decisions: No facts row: a commitment has no class, audience, status or schedule of its own.
